offering_description.value: Gen Digital sells online security, privacy and identity protection software to consumers and small businesses. It develops the software and delivers it through apps, websites and distribution partners, with identity restoration assistance for subscribers. In the United States, it also offers cash advances and credit-building loans and connects consumers with third-party financial products through an online marketplace.

primary_products.value: Device security software; online privacy tools; identity and credit monitoring tools; scam detection tools; personal finance apps

primary_services.value: Identity restoration assistance; cash advances; credit-building loans; financial product comparison and referrals

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individuals and households seeking online protection, identity monitoring or personal finance products; B2B: Small businesses buying cybersecurity and financial providers seeking consumer referrals

end_markets.value: Consumer cybersecurity; identity protection and privacy; small-business cybersecurity; consumer financial services

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring plans for device security, online privacy, identity protection and credit building; commissions or management fees: Referral payments from financial providers for leads and customer acquisitions; transaction or usage fees: Optional expedited delivery of cash advances; interest or premiums: Interest on credit-building loans
revenue_model.category: subscription; commissions or management fees; transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops security and personal finance software for consumers and small businesses; service provider: Helps subscribers recover from identity theft; financial intermediary: Connects consumers with third-party financial providers and offers credit-building loans
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Cybersecurity across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, with financial wellness centered in the United States

specialization.value: diversified: Consumer cybersecurity, privacy and identity protection alongside consumer lending and a financial product marketplace

distribution_channels.value: online: Company websites and mobile apps; partners / resellers: Device makers, telecom providers, employee benefits programs and financial marketplace partners; third-party retail: Electronics retailers and online stores selling security subscriptions

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State lending and federal consumer finance rules govern lending, while privacy rules govern handling of identity and credit data.
